details.task: Issue916 main924 policy adaptation and module-private test relocation.
details.observed: Tracing the actual consumer exposed an important directory dependency: modules/SCsub auto-collects tests/*.h into test_main, which lacks private HarfBuzz includes. The strict build failed after relocation. Keeping the test in internal_tests and including it from the module restored strict build success; regenerated global collection excludes it, bracket-only executes once with40 assertions and combined affected regressions pass38669 assertions. Independent read-only review confirmed inputs, logs and binaries. Directory names as well as suffixes can change the build consumer; this evidence covers the actual Windows consumer only.
